name: Bethany College
academic_ranking: Private four-year liberal arts college in Bethany, WV. Undergraduate-focused with an online graduate division (Bethany Online). Known for 'The Bethany Plan,' an experiential curriculum culminating in a senior project, and study-abroad affiliations in more than 50 countries. Specific enrollment, average class size, and student-faculty ratio figures were not published on the academics page checked 2026-07.
financial_aid: Tuition and fees listed at $41,898 for 2026-2027 (housing and food $15,260; total direct costs $57,158; total direct + indirect $59,964). School states FAFSA filers may be awarded $25,000 or more in scholarships, grants, and work-study. Financial aid contact: financialaid@bethanywv.edu.
facilities_notes: NCAA Division III program. Home softball venue not explicitly labeled on the softball landing page (bethanybison.com) as of 2026-07; athletics facilities listed include Bethany Park, Bison Field, Don Ault Field at Bison Stadium, and Hoag Field, but none specifically identified as the softball field.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III women's softball program competing in the Presidents' Athletic Conference (PAC). Small-college program with a three-member coaching staff for the 2026 season.
notes: Data gathered live 2026-07 from bethanybison.com (softball coaches and roster pages) and bethanywv.edu (tuition/academics). As an NCAA D3 institution, Bethany College does not offer athletic scholarships; scholarship_count set to null. No coach phone numbers or twitter/X handles are publicly listed on the softball staff directory (general college phone (304) 829-7000 appears only in the site footer).
